text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One night, after finishing training with 
Tosen Jordan...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Next, a run along the riverbank, 
then back to the dorm five minutes before 
curfew. All right, right on schedule today 
as well."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, running around there? Isn't it super 
crowded right now? The night view was 
trending like crazy on Umastagram.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No way...! I was not aware of that 
information.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Two minutes until departure. Is there time 
to change routes...? Or maybe cut the 
distance short... No, that won't—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, want me to show you a nice running 
route? One that's closer than the river.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I was actually just in the mood to hit 
that convenience store on the way~."
choice_data_list: Running any more is too much.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we go? It's dark, so 
don't trip, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please wait...! First, let's calculate 
the distance and time required...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Tosen Jordan ran more than usual.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh? Come on, you're being so 
stiff-headed!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, overrunning is indeed not good. I 
believe you made the right call.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'll be fine as long as you can show me 
the way, so please, guide me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aaalright, fine, I get it... Call me if 
you get lost. I'll be awake.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan quickly gave directions, 
watched them head off, and returned to the 
dorms.
